title: Conducting Stylistic Analysis of Paintings through an Art-History Agent
abstract: arXiv:2608.29644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attributing an artwork to an artist has traditionally relied on detailed visual observations and descriptions, known as stylistic analysis in art history. By contrast, current artificial intelligence (AI) models used in the field offer only unexplained probabilistic classifications. To bridge this methodological gap, we present an AI framework that automates stylistic analysis of paintings, providing a foundation for enhancing evidence collection, discovery, and verification. By training a vision transformer (ViT) on a large corpus of paintings with metadata, our system encodes this art history-specific data as embeddings. These representations are factorized via sparse dictionary learning into a shared set of features that recur across the training set. translated_title: 通过艺术史智能体对绘画进行风格分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.29644v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：将一件艺术品归属于某位艺术家，传统上依赖于细致的视觉观察与描述，这在艺术史学科中被称为风格分析。相比之下，当前该领域使用的人工智能（AI）模型只能提供无法解释的概率性分类结果。为了弥合这一方法论上的差距，我们提出了一个能够自动化绘画风格分析的AI框架，为增强证据收集、发现与验证奠定基础。通过在一个包含元数据的大型绘画语料库上训练视觉Transformer（ViT），我们的系统将这些艺术史领域的特定数据编码为嵌入向量。这些表示通过稀疏字典学习被分解为一组在训练集中反复出现的共享特征。随后，大型语言模型（LLM）通过检索与每个特征相关的艺术品及其随附的策展人撰写的文本，对其进行解释，并将它们综合成描述性文字……
tldr: 该研究提出了一个AI框架，利用视觉Transformer将绘画编码为嵌入、通过稀疏字典学习分解出可解释的共享风格特征，再由大语言模型结合策展人文本生成描述，从而实现了可解释的自动化绘画风格分析与艺术家归属。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an AI framework that automates explainable stylistic analysis of paintings by encoding art-history data with a vision transformer, factorizing representations into interpretable shared features via sparse dictionary learning, and using an LLM to synthesize curator-written texts into descriptive analyses.
